title: Call detail · {callId}
description: The session and the logs share one detail view; it shows the record as it was and does not reinterpret old verdicts with current settings.
executionNote: The execution result comes from the host; it is not a permission verdict.
partialSource: The detailed audit record is unavailable; below is only the minimal verdict information from memory or the session record, and missing parts are marked.
unreadable: This record's storage format is newer than the current plugin version, so only confirmable identifying fields are shown; it was not interpreted with the current structure.
ruleNameMissing: Not recorded (session records do not keep historical names)
chainResultsOnly: Only stage results were recorded; stage names and reasons were not saved:
snapshotMissingInputs: Missing inputs already marked when submitted for review
evidenceTruncated: Some authorization evidence was truncated by the length limit.
rawArgumentsSchemaMissing: The host did not declare an input schema.
noAttempts: This call was not sent to model review, so there are no model attempts.
missingUnknown: {count} more missing materials cannot be explained by the current version.

missing.auditDisabled: Audit storage is turned off, so the detailed record cannot be read.
missing.auditUnavailable: Audit storage is currently unavailable, so the detailed record cannot be read.
missing.auditRecordCleared: This record is not in the audit (it may have been cleaned up or passed its retention period).
missing.auditUnreadable: The current version cannot read the audit database structure.
missing.recordFormatNewer: The record format is newer than the current plugin version and was not interpreted with the current structure.
missing.snapshotUnreadable: The current version cannot interpret the review snapshot format.
missing.stagesMissing: This record saved no decision chain, so it is unknown whether model review ran.
missing.configMissing: No configuration snapshot from the time was saved.
missing.configUnreadable: The current version cannot interpret the configuration snapshot format from the time.
missing.modelAttemptsMissing: Model review ran, but no model attempts were saved.
missing.templateMissing: The template referenced by a model attempt was not saved.
missing.templateUnreadable: The current version cannot interpret the template format.
missing.stageDetailsMissing: Only stage results were saved; stage names and reasons are missing.
missing.ruleNameMissing: The rule's name at the time was not recorded.

executionStatus.pending: Waiting for the host to execute

recordUnavailable: This call was not found: none of the available sources (audit, memory and session record) has a matching record.
auditUnavailable: The audit database structure cannot be read, and neither memory nor the session record has a verdict for this call.
reviewUnknown: This record cannot confirm whether a model request was sent, and it has no review evidence to show.
evidenceLost: This record shows a model request was sent, but the review evidence was not saved.
attemptsLost: This record shows a model request was sent, but the model attempts were not saved.
attemptsUnknown: This record cannot confirm whether a model request was sent, and it has no model attempt records.
conflictsTitle: Two sources disagree about this call; both readings are kept below with no resolution.
conflictsTruncated: More conflicts exceed what a single record can represent, so only the first two readings were kept.
noEvidenceNotNeeded: This call sent no model request, so there is no review evidence.
noAttemptsNotNeeded: This call sent no model request, so there are no model attempts.
minimalVerdictHint: Neither the audit nor the verdict history has this call; the following comes from the current session record and has no decision chain or raw material.
conjunctionNoWitness: This record carries no conjunction node to show.
dialogDescription: Inspect the tool call verdict, decision basis, and raw audit materials.
createRuleOpen: Create a rule from this call
createRuleHint: Hands this call's recorded tool and arguments to a rule draft, pinning only the fields you choose; the draft still needs save-and-apply to take effect.
createRuleUnavailable: This record stored no input for the call, so no rule draft can be created from it.
